description:
Hello everyone! 🚀

I have developed a strong interest in practical problem-solving, creativity, experimentation, and turning ideas into tangible models. I am excited to participate in the NASA Space Apps Challenge to learn from others, explore space-related challenges, and contribute innovative ideas to a collaborative team.

My goal is to turn curiosity into innovation and contribute to ideas that could make a difference in our understanding of space. Let's explore beyond Earth together! 🚀
